## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 109 captures during April 2026. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The site should continue to monitor capture activity through routine operational review and ensure that any issues affecting the process are identified and recorded promptly.

## Image quality

There were 8 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 7.3. This result should be reviewed as part of the site’s routine quality monitoring. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate support process. Clear recording of equipment concerns will also help distinguish technical problems from other causes of ungradable images.

## Grading

Grading identified 19 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This should continue to be monitored alongside activity and image quality, with attention given to maintaining timely grading and appropriate follow-up of referable results. The findings provide a concise monthly view of service performance at Hill Counties Health Centre.
